title: Allocator arithmetic
hints: A power of two has exactly one bit set, so `n & (n - 1)` clears it and leaves 0.
`(value + align - 1) & ~(align - 1)` rounds up; `address & (align - 1)` is the remainder of dividing by `align`.
rules: Use the bit tricks (& and ~) instead of the remainder operator.

rules.message: Use the bit tricks (& and ~) instead of the remainder operator.
